title: Identify textless cards illustrated by either John Avon or Aleksi Briclot t
question: Identify textless cards illustrated by either John Avon or Aleksi Briclot that have non-powerful foil availability. For these cards, determine their legal status in the Legacy format and whether they appear in any set that has a Korean translation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049",
       T2."XCL_085",
       IIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T3."XCL_092" = 'Korean' AND NOT T3."XCL_094" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0, 'YES', 'NO')
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T3."XCL_093" = T1."XCL_063"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" IN ('John Avon', 'Aleksi Briclot')
  AND T1."XCL_022" = 1
  AND (T1."XCL_006" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_007" IS NULL)
  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_049", T2."XCL_085"

       T2."XCL_085",
       IIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T3."XCL_092" = 'Korean' AND NOT T3."XCL_094" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0, 'YES', 'NO')
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T3."XCL_093" = T1."XCL_063"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" IN ('John Avon', 'Aleksi Briclot')
  AND T1."XCL_022" = 1

  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_049", T2."XCL_085"

SELECT DISTINCT
  c.XCL_002,
  l.XCL_085 AS legacy_status,
  CASE WHEN st.XCL_091 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_korean_translation
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
LEFT JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_072 = s.XCL_095
LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093 AND st.XCL_094 = 'Korean'
WHERE c.XCL_003 IS NULL
  AND c.XCL_004 IN ('John Avon', 'Aleksi Briclot')
  AND c.XCL_005 = 'non-powerful'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'Legacy'
